bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 資治通鑑第188卷

translations.literal: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 188.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 188.

sentences.zh: 【唐紀四】起屠維單閼十一月，盡重光大荒落二月，凡一年有奇。

translations.literal: [Tang Records 4] From the eleventh month of the Tuwéi Danque year through the second month of the Chongguang Dahuangluo year—in all a little more than one year.
translations.idiomatic: [Tang Records 4], from the eleventh month of the Tuwéi Danque year through the second month of the Chongguang Dahuangluo year—a span of slightly more than one year.

sentences.zh: 十一月，己卯，劉武周寇浩州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jimao, Liu Wuzhou raided Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jimao, Liu Wuzhou attacked Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民引兵自龍門乘冰堅渡河，屯柏壁，與宋金剛相持。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin, Shimin, led troops from Longmen, crossed the river on solid ice, encamped at Baiyu, and faced Song Jingang in a stalemate.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, marched from Longmen, crossed the frozen river, and encamped at Baiyu, where he locked horns with Song Jingang.

sentences.zh: 時河東州縣，俘掠之餘，未有倉廩，人情恇擾，聚入城堡，征斂無所得，軍中乏食。

translations.literal: At that time the prefectures and counties of Hedong, after plunder and captivity, had no granaries; the people were fearful and unsettled, gathering into walled towns; levies yielded nothing, and the army lacked food.
translations.idiomatic: In Hedong, the prefectures and counties had been stripped bare by raiding; granaries were empty, the populace panicked and crowded into fortified towns, and levies brought in nothing—so the army went hungry.

sentences.zh: 世民發教諭民，民聞世民為帥而來，莫不歸附，自近及遠，至者日多，然後漸收其糧食，軍食以充。

translations.literal: Shimin issued proclamations to instruct the people; hearing that Shimin had come as commander, none failed to submit; from near to far, arrivals grew daily; then he gradually collected their grain, and army provisions were filled.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin issued reassuring proclamations to the people. When they heard he had come to command the army, they flocked to him from near and far until his camp was supplied with grain day by day, and the troops were fed.

sentences.zh: 乃休兵秣馬，唯令偏裨乘間抄掠，大軍堅壁不戰，由是賊勢日衰。

translations.literal: Thereupon he rested the troops and fed the horses, ordering only subordinate officers to raid when opportunity arose; the main army held the walls and did not fight, and thus the rebels' strength daily waned.
translations.idiomatic: He then rested his men and horses, sending only junior officers on opportunistic raids while the main force held its walls and refused battle—so the enemy's strength ebbed day by day.

sentences.zh: 世民嘗自帥輕騎覘敵，騎皆四散，世民獨與一甲士登丘而寢。

translations.literal: Shimin once personally led light cavalry to reconnoiter the enemy; the riders all scattered, and Shimin alone, with one armored soldier, climbed a hill and slept.
translations.idiomatic: Once Shimin led a light cavalry patrol to scout the enemy. His riders scattered, and he was left alone with a single armored man; the two climbed a hill and lay down to sleep.

sentences.zh: 俄而賊兵四合，初不之覺，會有蛇逐鼠，觸甲士之面，甲士驚寤，遂白世民，俱上馬，馳百餘步，為賊所及，世民以大羽箭射殪其驍將，賊騎乃退。

translations.literal: Soon rebel troops closed in on all sides; at first they did not notice. By chance a snake chased a rat and struck the armored man's face; he woke in alarm and told Shimin; both mounted and galloped a hundred-odd paces before the enemy caught up. Shimin shot and killed their fierce general with a great feathered arrow, and the rebel cavalry withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Before long rebel troops had them surrounded on every side, yet they still did not know it. Then a snake chasing a rat brushed the soldier's face; he started awake and warned Shimin. They mounted and fled a hundred paces or more before the pursuers caught up. Shimin brought down their boldest commander with a heavy war arrow, and the enemy cavalry fell back.

sentences.zh: 李世勣欲歸唐，恐禍及其父，謀於郭孝恪。

translations.literal: Li Shiji wished to return to Tang but feared harm would reach his father; he consulted Guo Xiaoke.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji wanted to defect to Tang but feared his father would pay the price, so he took counsel with Guo Xiaoke.

sentences.zh: 孝恪曰：「吾新事竇氏，動則見疑，宜先立效以取信，然後可圖也。

translations.literal: Xiaoke said: "I have newly entered Dou's service; any move will invite suspicion. We should first achieve merit to win trust, and only then can we plot."
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoke said, "We have only lately entered Dou Jian De's service—any move will raise suspicion. We must win his trust with a deed first; only then can we act."

sentences.zh: 」世勣從之。

translations.literal: " Shiji followed this plan.
translations.idiomatic: " Shiji agreed.

sentences.zh: 襲王世充獲嘉，破之，多所俘獲，以獻建德，建德由是親之。

translations.literal: They raided Wang Shichong's Huojia, defeated him, took many captives, and presented them to Jian De; Jian De therefore grew close to them.
translations.idiomatic: They struck Wang Shichong's garrison at Huojia, routed it, and sent a rich haul of captives to Dou Jian De, who thereafter treated them with favor.

sentences.zh: 初，漳南人劉黑闥，少驍勇狡獪，與竇建德善，後為群盜，轉事郝孝德、李密、王世充。

translations.literal: Earlier, Liu Heita of Zhangnan, bold and cunning from youth, was on good terms with Dou Jian De; later he became a bandit chief and in turn served Hao Xiaode, Li Mi, and Wang Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Heita of southern Zhang had been fierce and wily since youth and was friendly with Dou Jian De. He later led bandits and served in turn Hao Xiaode, Li Mi, and Wang Shichong.

sentences.zh: 世充以為騎將，每見世充所為，竊笑之。

translations.literal: Shichong made him a cavalry commander; whenever he saw what Shichong did, he secretly laughed at it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong appointed him a cavalry commander, but Heita privately mocked Shichong's conduct whenever he saw it.

sentences.zh: 世充使黑闥守新鄉，李世勣擊虜之，獻於建德。

translations.literal: Shichong sent Heita to hold Xinxiang; Li Shiji attacked and captured him and presented him to Jian De.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong posted Heita at Xinxiang; Li Shiji defeated and captured him and turned him over to Dou Jian De.

sentences.zh: 建德署為將軍，賜爵漢東公，常使將奇兵東西掩襲，或潛入敵境覘視虛實。

translations.literal: Jian De appointed him general and enfeoffed him as Duke of Handong; he often had him lead picked troops in raids east and west, or slip into enemy territory to spy out conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Jian De made him a general and created him Duke of Handong. Heita often led elite troops on swift strikes east and west, or stole into enemy lands to reconnoiter.

sentences.zh: 黑闥往往乘間奮擊，克獲而還。

translations.literal: Heita often seized openings to strike hard, took booty, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Heita repeatedly seized his chance, struck hard, and came back laden with spoils.

sentences.zh: 十二月，庚申，上獵於華山。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengshen, the Emperor hunted on Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day gengshen, the Emperor went hunting on Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 於筠說永安王孝基急攻呂崇茂，獨孤懷恩請先成攻具，然後進，孝基從之。

translations.literal: Yu Yun urged Prince Yong'an, Xiaoji, to attack Lü Chongmao at once; Dugu Huai'en asked to finish siege engines first and then advance; Xiaoji followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yun urged Prince Yong'an Li Xiaoji to attack Lü Chongmao immediately, but Dugu Huai'en wanted siege equipment finished first. Xiaoji took Huai'en's advice.

sentences.zh: 崇茂求救於宋金剛，金剛遣其將善陽尉遲敬德、尋相將兵奄至夏縣。

translations.literal: Chongmao sought aid from Song Jingang; Jingang sent his generals Shanyang Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang with troops that suddenly arrived at Xia County.
translations.idiomatic: Chongmao called on Song Jingang for help. Jingang sent his generals Yuchi Jingde of Shanyang and Xun Xiang, whose troops suddenly appeared at Xia County.

sentences.zh: 孝基表裡受敵，軍遂大敗，孝基、懷恩、筠、唐儉及行軍總管劉世讓皆為所虜。

translations.literal: Xiaoji was attacked from within and without; the army was utterly defeated; Xiaoji, Huai'en, Yun, Tang Jian, and the campaign commander Liu Shirang were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Caught between enemies inside and out, Xiaoji's army was shattered. Xiaoji, Huai'en, Yun, Tang Jian, and the campaign commander Liu Shirang were all taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 敬德名恭，以字行。

translations.literal: Jingde's given name was Gong; he was known by his courtesy name.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde's personal name was Gong; he went by his courtesy name.

sentences.zh: 上征裴寂入朝，責其敗軍，下吏，既而釋之，寵待彌厚。

translations.literal: The Emperor summoned Pei Ji to court, rebuked him for the defeated army, handed him to the officials, then released him and treated him with still greater favor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor recalled Pei Ji to court, blamed him for the defeat, and had him placed under arrest—then released him and showed him even greater favor than before.

sentences.zh: 尉遲敬德、尋相將還澮州，秦王世民遣兵部尚書殷開山、總管秦叔寶等邀之於美良川，大破之，斬首二千餘級。

translations.literal: Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang were returning to Huai Prefecture; the Prince of Qin, Shimin, sent the Minister of War Yin Kaishan, the commander Qin Shubao, and others to intercept them at Meiliang River; they routed them and took more than two thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: As Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang marched back toward Huai, the Prince of Qin sent Yin Kaishan, Minister of War, and the commander Qin Shubao to ambush them at Meiliang River. The Tang force crushed them and took more than two thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 頃之，敬德、尋相潛引精騎援王行本於蒲板，世民自將步騎三千，從間道夜趨安邑，邀擊，大破之，敬德、相僅以身免，悉俘其眾，復歸柏壁。

translations.literal: Soon after, Jingde and Xun Xiang secretly led picked cavalry to relieve Wang Xingben at Puban; Shimin personally led three thousand foot and horse by a hidden road by night to Anyi, intercepted them, and routed them; Jingde and Xiang barely escaped with their lives; all their troops were captured; he returned to Baiyu.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Jingde and Xun Xiang slipped away with elite cavalry to relieve Wang Xingben at Puban. Shimin led three thousand infantry and cavalry by a back road under cover of night to Anyi, struck them, and won a crushing victory. Jingde and Xiang escaped only with their lives; their entire force was captured, and Shimin returned to Baiyu.

sentences.zh: 諸將咸請與宋金剛戰，世民曰：「金剛懸軍深入，精兵猛將，咸聚於是。

translations.literal: The generals all asked to give battle to Song Jingang; Shimin said: "Jingang has led his army deep in hostile country; his elite troops and fierce generals are all gathered here."
translations.idiomatic: The generals all urged a pitched battle with Song Jingang. Shimin said, "Jingang has driven deep into our territory, and his best troops and boldest commanders are massed here."

sentences.zh: 武周據太原，倚金剛為□蔽。

translations.literal: Wuzhou holds Taiyuan and relies on Jingang as his shield.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wuzhou holds Taiyuan and depends on Jingang as his shield.

sentences.zh: 金剛軍無蓄積，以虜掠為資，利在速戰。

translations.literal: Jingang's army has no stores and lives on plunder; it profits from swift battle.
translations.idiomatic: Jingang's army has no reserves and lives on loot—it needs a quick fight.

sentences.zh: 我閉營養銳以挫其鋒，分兵汾、隰，沖其心腹。

translations.literal: We should close camp, rest our strength, and blunt their edge; send detachments to Fen and Xi to strike their heartland.
translations.idiomatic: We should hold our camps, husband our strength, and wear them down, while detachments strike Fen and Xi and hit them in the vitals.

sentences.zh: 彼糧盡計窮，自當遁走。

translations.literal: When their grain is gone and their plans exhausted, they will flee of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When their food runs out and their options fail, they will retreat on their own.

sentences.zh: 當待此機，未宜速戰。

translations.literal: We should wait for that moment; it is not yet time to fight quickly.
translations.idiomatic: We must wait for that moment—not rush into battle now.

sentences.zh: 永安壯王孝基謀逃歸，劉武周殺之。

translations.literal: Prince Yong'an the Bold, Xiaoji, plotted to escape and return; Liu Wuzhou killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yong'an Li Xiaoji plotted to escape back to Tang, and Liu Wuzhou had him executed.

sentences.zh: 李世勣復遣人說竇建德曰：「曹、戴二州，戶口完實，孟海公竊有其地，與鄭人外合內離；

translations.literal: Li Shiji again sent someone to persuade Dou Jian De, saying: "The two prefectures of Cao and Dai have intact populations; Meng Haigong has seized their lands and is outwardly allied with Zheng but inwardly divided;"
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji again sent an envoy to persuade Dou Jian De: "The prefectures of Cao and Dai still have full populations. Meng Haigong holds them by theft and is allied with Zheng on the surface but divided within;"

sentences.zh: 若以大軍臨之，指期可取。

translations.literal: if a great army presses them, they can be taken within a set term.
translations.idiomatic: if you march on them in force, you can take them within days.

sentences.zh: 既得海公，以臨徐、兗，河南可不戰而定也。

translations.literal: Once Haigong is taken, pressing Xu and Yan, the lands south of the Yellow River can be settled without battle.
translations.idiomatic: Once Haigong falls, you can threaten Xu and Yan, and all of Henan may submit without a fight.

sentences.zh: 」建德以為然，欲自將徇河南，先遣其行臺曹旦等將兵五萬濟河，世勣引兵三千會之。

translations.literal: " Jian De thought this right, wished to lead in person to pacify Henan, and first sent his mobile headquarters commander Cao Dan and others with fifty thousand troops to cross the river; Shiji led three thousand to join them.
translations.idiomatic: " Jian De agreed and planned to lead the campaign south of the river himself. He first sent his field headquarters commander Cao Dan with fifty thousand men across the Yellow River; Shiji joined them with three thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，將軍秦武通攻王行本於蒲板。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, the general Qin Wutong attacked Wang Xingben at Puban.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, General Qin Wutong besieged Wang Xingben at Puban.

sentences.zh: 行本出戰而敗，糧盡援絕，欲突圍走，無隨之者，戊寅，開門出降。

translations.literal: Xingben went out to fight and was defeated; grain was exhausted and relief cut off; he wished to break out and flee but none would follow; on the day wuyin he opened the gates and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Xingben sallied out and was beaten. With food gone and no relief coming, he tried to break out—but no one would follow. On the day wuyin he opened the gates and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上幸蒲州，斬行本。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the Emperor visited Pu Prefecture and executed Xingben.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi the Emperor went to Pu Prefecture and executed Xingben.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民輕騎謁上於蒲州。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin, Shimin, came on light horse to pay his respects to the Emperor at Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin rode ahead with a light escort to greet the Emperor at Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋金剛圍絳州。

translations.literal: Song Jingang besieged Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jingang laid siege to Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上還長安。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the Emperor returned to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi the Emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 李世勣謀俟竇建德至河南，掩襲其營，殺之，冀得其父並建德土地以歸唐。

translations.literal: Li Shiji plotted to wait until Dou Jian De reached Henan, then storm his camp and kill him, hoping to recover his father and Jian De's lands for Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji planned to wait until Dou Jian De reached Henan, then surprise his camp, kill him, and win back both his father and Jian De's territory for Tang.

sentences.zh: 會建德妻產，久之不至。

translations.literal: As it happened Jian De's wife was in childbirth, and for a long time he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: But Jian De's wife was giving birth, and he delayed his departure for a long while.

sentences.zh: 曹旦，建德之妻兄也，在河南，多所侵擾，諸賊羈屬者皆怨之。

translations.literal: Cao Dan, Jian De's wife's elder brother, was in Henan and greatly harassed the people; all the bandit chiefs under constraint resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Dan, the elder brother of Jian De's wife, was in Henan and preyed heavily on the countryside, and every subordinate bandit leader resented him.

sentences.zh: 賊帥魏郡李文相，號李商胡，聚眾五千餘人，據孟津中水單；

translations.literal: The bandit chief Li Wenxiang of Wei Commandery, styled Li Shanghu, gathered more than five thousand men and held the Zhongshuidan crossing at Mengjin;
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief Li Wenxiang of Wei Commandery, who took the name Li Shanghu, mustered more than five thousand men and held the Zhongshuidan ford at Mengjin;

sentences.zh: 母霍氏，亦善騎射，自稱霍總管。

translations.literal: his mother, Lady Huo, was also skilled in riding and archery and styled herself Director-General Huo.
translations.idiomatic: his mother, Lady Huo, was herself a fine rider and archer and called herself Director-General Huo.

sentences.zh: 世勣結商胡為昆弟，入拜商胡之母。

translations.literal: Shiji bound himself to Shanghu as sworn brothers and went in to pay respects to Shanghu's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Shiji swore brotherhood with Shanghu and went to pay his respects to Shanghu's mother.

sentences.zh: 母泣謂世勣曰：「竇氏無道，如何事之！

translations.literal: The mother wept and said to Shiji: "The Dou house is without the Way—how can you serve them!"
translations.idiomatic: The old woman wept and said to Shiji, "The Dou clan is wicked—why serve them at all?"

sentences.zh: 」世勣曰：「母無憂，不過一月，當殺之，相與歸唐耳！

translations.literal: " Shiji said: "Mother, do not worry; within a month we shall kill him and return to Tang together!"
translations.idiomatic: " Shiji said, "Do not grieve, Mother—in a month at most we will kill him and all go over to Tang together!"

sentences.zh: 」世勣辭去，母謂商胡曰：「東海公許我共圖此賊，事久變生，何必待其來，不如速決。

translations.literal: " When Shiji had left, the mother said to Shanghu: "The Duke of Donghai promised us to plot against this bandit together; if the affair drags on, change may arise—why wait for him to come? Better decide quickly."
translations.idiomatic: " After Shiji left, the mother told Shanghu, "The Duke of Donghai has pledged to strike this enemy with us. Delays breed trouble—why wait for him? Act at once."

sentences.zh: 」是夜，商胡召曹旦偏裨二十三人，飲之酒，盡殺之。

translations.literal: " That night Shanghu summoned twenty-three of Cao Dan's subordinate officers, gave them wine, and killed them all.
translations.idiomatic: " That night Shanghu invited twenty-three of Cao Dan's junior officers to drink and slaughtered every one of them.

sentences.zh: 旦別將高雅賢、阮君明尚在河北未濟，商胡以巨舟四艘濟河北之兵三百人，至中流，悉殺之。

translations.literal: Dan's separate commanders Gao Yaxian and Ruan Junming were still north of the river and had not crossed; Shanghu used four great boats to ferry three hundred of the troops north of the river; at midstream he killed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Dan's lieutenants Gao Yaxian and Ruan Junming were still on the north bank. Shanghu sent four large boats to ferry three hundred of their men across—and had them all killed midstream.

sentences.zh: 有獸醫游水得免，至南岸，告曹旦，旦嚴警為備。

translations.literal: A veterinary officer swam free, reached the south bank, and told Cao Dan; Dan tightened guard and made ready.
translations.idiomatic: A veterinary officer swam ashore, reached the south bank, and warned Cao Dan, who at once tightened his defenses.

sentences.zh: 商胡既舉事，始遣人告李世勣。

translations.literal: Only after Shanghu had risen did he send someone to inform Li Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: Only after the rising did Shanghu send word to Li Shiji.

sentences.zh: 世勣與曹旦連營，郭孝恪勸世勣襲旦，世勣未決，聞旦已有備，遂與孝恪帥數十騎來奔。

translations.literal: Shiji was encamped with Cao Dan; Guo Xiaoke urged Shiji to strike Dan; Shiji had not decided; hearing Dan was already on guard, he and Xiaoke led several dozen horsemen and fled to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Shiji's camp adjoined Cao Dan's. Guo Xiaoke urged a surprise attack, but Shiji hesitated; when he learned Dan was alert, he and Xiaoke fled to Tang with only a few dozen horsemen.

sentences.zh: 商胡復引精兵二千北襲阮君明，破之。

translations.literal: Shanghu again led two thousand picked troops north to strike Ruan Junming and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghu then led two thousand elite troops north, routed Ruan Junming, and broke his force.

sentences.zh: 高雅賢收眾去，商胡追之，不及而還。

translations.literal: Gao Yaxian gathered his men and withdrew; Shanghu pursued but could not catch up and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yaxian gathered what was left of his force and withdrew. Shanghu pursued but failed to overtake him and turned back.

sentences.zh: 建德群臣請誅李蓋，建德曰：「世勣，唐臣，為我所虜，不忘本朝，乃忠臣也，其父何罪！

translations.literal: Jian De's ministers asked to execute Li Gai; Jian De said: "Shiji is a Tang minister, captured by me, yet he does not forget his own court—he is a loyal minister; what crime has his father!"
translations.idiomatic: Jian De's ministers demanded that Li Gai be put to death. Jian De said, "Shiji is a Tang official whom I hold captive, yet he has not forgotten his sovereign—that is loyalty. What fault lies with his father?"

sentences.zh: 」遂赦之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: " He spared Li Gai.

sentences.zh: 甲午，世勣、孝恪至長安。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Shiji and Xiaoke reached Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Shiji and Xiaoke arrived in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 曹旦遂取濟州，復還洺州。

translations.literal: Cao Dan then took Ji Prefecture and returned again to Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Dan seized Ji Prefecture and withdrew to Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚子，上幸華陰。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengzi, the Emperor visited Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day gengzi, the Emperor went to Huayin.

sentences.zh: 劉武周遣兵寇潞州，陷長子、壺關。

translations.literal: Liu Wuzhou sent troops to raid Lu Prefecture and took Changzi and Huguan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wuzhou sent troops against Lu Prefecture and captured Changzi and Huguan.

sentences.zh: 潞州刺史郭子武不能御，上以將軍河東王行敏助之。

translations.literal: The prefect of Lu, Guo Ziwu, could not resist; the Emperor sent the general Hedong Wang Xingmin to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect of Lu, Guo Ziwu, could not hold them off, so the Emperor sent the general Wang Xingmin of Hedong to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 行敏與子武不葉，或言子武將叛，行敏斬子武以徇。

translations.literal: Xingmin and Ziwu were not on good terms; someone said Ziwu would rebel; Xingmin executed Ziwu as an example.
translations.idiomatic: Xingmin and Ziwu were at odds. When word spread that Ziwu might defect, Xingmin executed him as a warning to the army.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，武周復遣兵寇潞州，行敏擊破之。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Wuzhou again sent troops to raid Lu Prefecture; Xingmin attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi Liu Wuzhou attacked Lu again; Xingmin routed the invaders.

sentences.zh: 壬子，開州蠻酋冉肇則陷通州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the tribal chief of Kai Prefecture, Ran Zhaoze, took Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi Ran Zhaoze, a tribal leader of Kai Prefecture, captured Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣將軍桑顯和等攻呂崇茂於夏縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin the Emperor sent the general Sang Xianhe and others to attack Lü Chongmao at Xia County.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin he sent General Sang Xianhe and others to attack Lü Chongmao at Xia County.

sentences.zh: 初，工部尚書獨孤懷恩攻蒲板，久不下，失亡多，上數以敕書誚讓之，懷恩由是怨望。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Minister of Works Dugu Huai'en attacked Puban but for long could not take it; losses were heavy; the Emperor repeatedly rebuked him by edict; Huai'en therefore nursed resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Minister of Works Dugu Huai'en had besieged Puban for a long time without success, suffering heavy losses. The Emperor rebuked him again and again by edict, and Huai'en grew bitter.

sentences.zh: 上嘗戲謂懷恩曰：「姑之子皆已為天子，次應至舅之子乎？

translations.literal: The Emperor once jested to Huai'en: "Sons of an aunt have all become emperors—is it next the turn of a maternal uncle's son?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor once teased him: "Sons of an aunt have all become emperors—surely it is an uncle's son next?"

sentences.zh: 」懷恩亦頗以此自負，或時扼腕曰：「我家豈女獨貴乎？

translations.literal: " Huai'en also took considerable pride in this; sometimes he clenched his wrist and said: "Is my house to be honored only through women?"
translations.idiomatic: " Huai'en took the remark to heart. Sometimes he would clench his fist and mutter, "Must our house rise only through its women?"

sentences.zh: 」遂與麾下元君寶謀反。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he plotted rebellion with his subordinate Yuan Junbao.
translations.idiomatic: " He then conspired to rebel with his follower Yuan Junbao.

sentences.zh: 會懷恩、君寶與唐儉皆沒於尉遲敬德，君寶謂儉曰：「獨孤尚書近謀大事，若能早決，豈有此辱哉！

translations.literal: As it happened Huai'en, Junbao, and Tang Jian were all captured by Yuchi Jingde; Junbao said to Jian: "Minister Dugu lately plotted a great affair—had we decided early, would we have suffered this disgrace!"
translations.idiomatic: When Huai'en, Junbao, and Tang Jian fell into Yuchi Jingde's hands, Junbao told Jian, "Minister Dugu was plotting a coup—if we had acted sooner, we would not be in this humiliation!"

sentences.zh: 」及秦王世民敗敬德於美良川，懷恩逃歸，上復使之將兵攻蒲板。

translations.literal: " When the Prince of Qin defeated Jingde at Meiliang River, Huai'en escaped and returned; the Emperor again had him lead troops to attack Puban.
translations.idiomatic: " After the Prince of Qin defeated Jingde at Meiliang River, Huai'en escaped back to Tang, and the Emperor again put him in command against Puban.

sentences.zh: 君寶又謂儉曰：「獨孤尚書遂拔難得還，復在蒲板，可謂王者不死！

translations.literal: Junbao again said to Jian: "Minister Dugu has indeed escaped hardship and returned, and is again at Puban—truly, a king cannot be killed!"
translations.idiomatic: Junbao told Jian again, "Minister Dugu has slipped free once more and is back at Puban—a man destined for the throne cannot be killed!"

sentences.zh: 」儉恐懷恩遂成其謀，乃說尉遲敬德，請使劉世讓還與唐連和，敬德從之，遂以懷恩反狀聞。

translations.literal: " Jian feared Huai'en would carry out his plot; he therefore persuaded Yuchi Jingde to ask that Liu Shirang be sent back to ally with Tang; Jingde agreed, and thus reported Huai'en's rebellious conduct.
translations.idiomatic: " Fearing Huai'en would succeed, Jian persuaded Yuchi Jingde to send Liu Shirang back to negotiate an alliance with Tang. Jingde agreed, and Jian reported Huai'en's treason.

sentences.zh: 時王行本已降，懷恩入據其城，上方濟河幸懷恩營，已登舟矣，世讓適至。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Xingben had already surrendered; Huai'en entered and held his city; the Emperor was about to cross the river to visit Huai'en's camp and had already boarded the boat when Shirang arrived just then.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xingben had already surrendered, and Huai'en had occupied his city. The Emperor was crossing the river to visit Huai'en's camp and had already stepped aboard when Shirang arrived.

sentences.zh: 上大驚曰：「吾得免，豈非天也！

translations.literal: The Emperor said in great alarm: "That I escaped—is this not Heaven's doing!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor cried out in alarm, "Heaven itself saved me!"

sentences.zh: 」乃使召懷恩，懷恩未知事露，輕舟來至；

translations.literal: " He then sent to summon Huai'en; Huai'en did not know the affair was exposed and came in a light boat;
translations.idiomatic: " He sent for Huai'en, who did not yet know he was exposed and came in a small boat;

sentences.zh: 即執以屬吏，分捕黨與。

translations.literal: he was immediately seized and handed to the officials, and parties were sent to capture his accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: they seized him at once and handed him to the law officers, while detachments rounded up his accomplices.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，誅懷恩及其黨。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Huai'en and his faction were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin Huai'en and his followers were put to death.

sentences.zh: 竇建德攻李商胡，殺之。

translations.literal: Dou Jian De attacked Li Shanghu and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Jian De attacked Li Shanghu and killed him.

sentences.zh: 建德洺州勸課農桑，境內無盜，商旅野宿。

translations.literal: Jian De at Ming Prefecture urged agriculture and sericulture; within his borders there were no bandits, and merchants and travelers slept in the open.
translations.idiomatic: At Ming Prefecture Jian De promoted farming and silkworm raising; banditry vanished within his borders, and merchants camped in the open without fear.

sentences.zh: 突厥處羅可汗迎楊政道，立為隋王。

translations.literal: The Türk Qaghan Chuluo welcomed Yang Zhengdao and established him as King of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: The Türk Qaghan Chuluo welcomed Yang Zhengdao and set him up as King of Sui.

sentences.zh: 中國士民在北者，處羅悉以配之，有眾萬人。

translations.literal: All Chinese gentry and commoners in the north Chuluo assigned to him, and he had a following of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Chuluo assigned to him every Chinese scholar and commoner still in the north, giving him a following of ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 置百官，皆依隋制，居於定襄。

translations.literal: He set up the hundred offices, all following Sui institutions, and dwelt at Dingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He installed a full court on the Sui model and made his seat at Dingxiang.

sentences.zh: 三月，乙丑，劉武周遣其將張萬歲寇浩州，李仲文擊走之，俘斬數千人。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yichou, Liu Wuzhou sent his general Zhang Wansui to raid Haozhou; Li Zhongwen drove him off and captured or killed several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day yichou, Liu Wuzhou sent Zhang Wansui against Haozhou. Li Zhongwen repulsed him and took several thousand prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 改納言為侍中，內史令為中書令，給事郎為給事中。

translations.literal: Nayan was changed to Shizhong, Neishiling to Zhongshuling, and Jishilang to Jishizhong.
translations.idiomatic: The titles Nayan, Neishiling, and Jishilang were renamed Shizhong, Zhongshuling, and Jishizhong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以內史侍郎卦德彝為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu the Vice Director of the Secretariat Feng Deyi was made Zhongshuling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Feng Deyi, Vice Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 王世充將帥、州縣來降者，時月相繼。

translations.literal: Wang Shichong's generals and prefectures and counties that came over to surrender did so month after month in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Month after month, Wang Shichong's commanders and local officials defected to Tang.

sentences.zh: 世充乃峻其法，一人亡叛，舉家無少長就戮，父子、兄弟、夫婦許相告而免之。

translations.literal: Shichong then made his laws harsh: if one man fled or rebelled, the whole household, young and old alike, was put to death; father and son, brothers, and husband and wife were allowed to inform on one another to escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong tightened the laws: one deserter meant death for every member of his household, young and old. Fathers and sons, brothers, and husbands and wives could denounce one another to save themselves.

sentences.zh: 又使五家為保，有舉家亡者，四鄰不覺，皆坐誅。

translations.literal: He also made five households a mutual guarantee: if an entire household fled and the four neighboring households did not notice, all were punished with execution.
translations.idiomatic: He grouped households in fives as mutual guarantors: if an entire family fled and the four neighboring families failed to report it, all were executed.

sentences.zh: 殺人益多而亡者益甚，至於樵采之人，出入皆有限數；

translations.literal: The more were killed, the more fled; even woodcutters and gatherers had fixed limits on going out and coming in;
translations.idiomatic: The more he killed, the more people fled. Even woodcutters and foragers were rationed in how often they might leave and return;

sentences.zh: 公私愁窘，人不聊生。

translations.literal: public and private were in distress, and the people could scarcely live.
translations.idiomatic: public and private life alike were desperate, and the people could barely survive.

sentences.zh: 又以宮城為大獄，意所忌者，並其家屬收系宮中；

translations.literal: He also made the palace city a great prison; those he suspected, together with their families, were seized and held in the palace;
translations.idiomatic: He turned the palace into a vast prison. Anyone he suspected, together with his family, was locked up inside;

sentences.zh: 諸將出討，亦質其家屬於宮中，禁止者常不減萬口，餒死者日有數十。

translations.literal: when generals went out on campaign, their families too were held hostage in the palace; those confined never fell below ten thousand mouths, and dozens starved to death each day.
translations.idiomatic: when generals marched out on campaign, their families were held hostage in the palace as well. The prisoners never numbered fewer than ten thousand, and dozens starved to death every day.

sentences.zh: 世充又以臺省官為司、鄭、管、原、伊、殷、梁、湊、嵩、谷、懷、德等十二州營田使，丞、郎得為此行者，喜若登仙。

translations.literal: Shichong also made Secretariat and Department officials agricultural commissioners for the twelve prefectures of Si, Zheng, Guan, Yuan, Yi, Yin, Liang, Cou, Song, Gu, Huai, and De; assistants and bureau directors who received such appointments rejoiced as if ascending to immortality.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong also appointed Secretariat and Department officials as agricultural commissioners over twelve prefectures. Assistants and directors lucky enough to receive such posts rejoiced as though they had become immortals.

sentences.zh: 甲申，行軍副總管張倫敗劉武周於浩州，俘斬千餘人。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the deputy campaign commander Zhang Lun defeated Liu Wuzhou at Haozhou, capturing and killing more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, Deputy Campaign Commander Zhang Lun defeated Liu Wuzhou at Haozhou, capturing and killing over a thousand of his men.

sentences.zh: 西河公張綸、真鄉公李仲文引兵臨石州，劉季真懼而詐降。

translations.literal: The Duke of Xihe, Zhang Lun, and the Duke of Zhenxiang, Li Zhongwen, led troops to approach Shizhou; Liu Jizhen, in fear, feigned surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Xihe Zhang Lun and the Duke of Zhenxiang Li Zhongwen marched on Shizhou; Liu Jizhen, frightened, pretended to surrender.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以季真為石州總管，賜姓李氏，封彭山郡王。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Jizhen was made commander of Shizhou, granted the surname Li, and enfeoffed as Prince of Pengshan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, Jizhen was appointed commander of Shizhou, given the imperial surname Li, and enfeoffed as Prince of Pengshan.

sentences.zh: 蠻酋冉肇則寇信州，趙郡公孝恭與戰，不利。

translations.literal: The barbarian chieftain Ran Zhaize raided Xin Prefecture; the Duke of Zhao Commandery, Xiaogong, fought him and fared poorly.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal chieftain Ran Zhaize attacked Xin Prefecture; the Duke of Zhao Commandery Li Xiaogong met him in battle and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 李靖將兵八百，襲擊，斬之，俘五千餘人；

translations.literal: Li Jing led eight hundred troops in a surprise attack, killed him, and took more than five thousand captives;
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing led eight hundred men in a surprise raid, killed Zhaize, and took more than five thousand prisoners;

sentences.zh: 己丑，復開、通二州。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the two prefectures of Kai and Tong were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Kai and Tong prefectures were restored to Tang control.

sentences.zh: 孝恭又擊蕭銑東平王闍提，斬之。

translations.literal: Xiaogong again attacked Xiao Xian's Prince of Dongping, Sheti, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaogong then attacked Sheti, Prince of Dongping under Xiao Xian, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丙申，上祠華山；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingshen, the Emperor sacrificed at Mount Hua;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingshen, the Emperor performed rites at Mount Hua;

sentences.zh: 壬寅，還長安。

translations.literal: On the day renyin he returned to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin he returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 置益州道行臺，以益、利、會、鄜、涇、遂六總管隸焉。

translations.literal: A Yizhou Circuit mobile headquarters was established, with the six area commands of Yi, Li, Hui, Fu, Jing, and Sui placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: A mobile headquarters for the Yizhou circuit was set up, placing the six area commands of Yi, Li, Hui, Fu, Jing, and Sui under its authority.

sentences.zh: 劉武周數攻浩州，為李仲文所敗。

translations.literal: Liu Wuzhou repeatedly attacked Haozhou and was defeated by Li Zhongwen.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wuzhou attacked Haozhou several times and was repulsed each time by Li Zhongwen.

sentences.zh: 宋金剛軍中食盡；

translations.literal: Song Jingang's army exhausted its food;
translations.idiomatic: Song Jingang's army ran out of provisions;

sentences.zh: 丁未，金剛北走，秦王世民追之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Jingang fled north; the Prince of Qin, Shimin, pursued him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, Jingang retreated north; the Prince of Qin Li Shimin gave chase.

sentences.zh: 羅士信圍慈澗，王世充使太子玄應救之，士信刺玄應墜馬，人救之，得免。

translations.literal: Luo Shixin besieged Cijian; Wang Shichong sent the crown prince Xuanying to relieve it; Shixin speared Xuanying and knocked him from his horse; men rescued him, and he escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shixin besieged Cijian; Wang Shichong sent Crown Prince Xuanying to the rescue. Shixin speared Xuanying and knocked him from his horse, but attendants pulled him to safety.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以顯州道行臺楊士林為行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Yang Sulin of the Xianzhou Circuit mobile headquarters was made chief minister of the mobile headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, Yang Sulin of the Xianzhou mobile headquarters was appointed chief minister of the field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，加秦王世民益州道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Prince of Qin, Shimin, was additionally made chief minister of the Yizhou Circuit mobile headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, the Prince of Qin Li Shimin was also made chief minister of the Yizhou mobile headquarters.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民追及尋相於呂州，大破之，乘勝逐北，一晝夜行二百餘里，戰數十合。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin, Shimin, caught up with Xun Xiang at Lü Prefecture and routed him; riding victory he pursued the fleeing foe, marching more than two hundred li in a day and night and fighting several dozen engagements.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin caught Xun Xiang at Lü Prefecture and crushed him. Pressing the pursuit, he drove north for over two hundred li in a single day and night, fighting several dozen skirmishes along the way.

sentences.zh: 至高壁嶺，總管劉弘基執轡諫曰：「大王破賊，逐北至此，功亦足矣。

translations.literal: At Gaobiling, the commander Liu Hongji took the reins and remonstrated, saying: "Your Highness has broken the rebels and pursued them this far—your achievement is already enough.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaobiling, Commander Liu Hongji seized the bridle and urged: "Your Highness has shattered the enemy and chased them this far. That is glory enough.

sentences.zh: 深入不已，不愛身乎！

translations.literal: To press deeper without end—do you not cherish your own life!
translations.idiomatic: To drive on like this—do you not value your own life?

sentences.zh: 且士卒饑疲，宜留壁於此，俟兵糧畢集，然後復進，未晚也。

translations.literal: Moreover the soldiers are hungry and weary; you should hold the walls here, wait until troops and grain are fully gathered, and then advance again—it would not be too late.
translations.idiomatic: Your men are hungry and exhausted. Hold here, wait until reinforcements and supplies arrive, then advance—it will not be too late.

sentences.zh: 」世民曰：「金剛計窮而走，眾心離沮；

translations.literal: " Shimin said: "Jingang's plans are exhausted and he flees; the hearts of his host are divided and dispirited;
translations.idiomatic: " Shimin replied: "Jingang is at his wit's end and running; his troops' morale is broken;

sentences.zh: 功難成而易敗，機難得而易失，必乘此勢取之。

translations.literal: success is hard to achieve and easy to lose; opportunity is hard to gain and easy to miss—we must seize this momentum and take them.
translations.idiomatic: victory is easily lost once won, and opportunity slips away in an instant. We must strike now, while the momentum is ours.

sentences.zh: 若更淹留，使之計立備成，不可復攻矣。

translations.literal: If we delay further and let them settle their plans and complete their defenses, they cannot be attacked again.
translations.idiomatic: If we linger and give them time to regroup and fortify, we will never break them again.

sentences.zh: 吾竭忠徇國，豈顧身乎！

translations.literal: I exhaust loyalty and give myself to the state—how would I care for my own person!
translations.idiomatic: I serve the realm with all my loyalty—why should I spare myself!

sentences.zh: 」遂策馬而進，將士不敢復言饑。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he spurred his horse forward; officers and soldiers dared not speak of hunger again.
translations.idiomatic: " With that he spurred ahead, and none of his officers or men complained of hunger again.

sentences.zh: 追及金剛於雀鼠谷，一日八戰，皆破之，俘斬數萬人。

translations.literal: He caught up with Jingang at Queshu Valley; in one day they fought eight battles, all victories, capturing and killing tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He overtook Jingang at Queshu Valley and fought eight battles in a single day, winning every one and killing or capturing tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 夜，宿於雀鼠谷西原，世民不食二日，不解甲三日矣，軍中止有一羊，世民與將士分而食之。

translations.literal: At night he encamped on the western plain of Queshu Valley; Shimin had not eaten for two days and had not removed his armor for three; the army had only one sheep, and Shimin shared it with his officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That night they camped on the western plain of Queshu Valley. Shimin had gone two days without food and three without removing his armor. The army had only one sheep; he divided it among his officers and men.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陝州總管於筠自金剛所逃來。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Yu Jun, commander of Shaan Prefecture, fled from Jingang's camp and came over.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, Yu Jun, the commander of Shaan Prefecture, deserted Song Jingang and came over to Tang.

sentences.zh: 世民引兵趣介休，金剛尚有眾二萬，戊午，出西門，背城布陳，南北七里。

translations.literal: Shimin led troops toward Jiexiu; Jingang still had twenty thousand men; on the day wuwu he went out the west gate, drew up battle lines with the city at his back, stretching seven li north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin marched on Jiexiu. Jingang still had twenty thousand men. On the day wuwu he sallied from the west gate and formed battle lines with the city behind him, seven li from end to end.

sentences.zh: 世民遣總管李世勣等與戰，小卻，為賊所乘。

translations.literal: Shimin sent the commander Li Shiji and others to fight; they fell back slightly and were exploited by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin sent Li Shiji and other commanders into battle; they gave ground slightly and the enemy pressed the advantage.

sentences.zh: 世民帥精騎擊之，出其陳後，金剛大敗，斬首三千級。

translations.literal: Shimin led picked cavalry to strike them, coming out behind their battle line; Jingang was utterly defeated, and three thousand heads were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin led elite cavalry in a counterattack, hitting them from the rear. Jingang was routed, and three thousand heads were taken.

sentences.zh: 金剛輕騎走，世民追之數十里，至張難堡。

translations.literal: Jingang fled on light horse; Shimin pursued him several tens of li to Zhangnan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Jingang fled with a light escort; Shimin chased him for dozens of li as far as Zhangnan Fort.

sentences.zh: 浩州行軍總管樊伯通、張德政據堡自守，世民免冑示之，堡中喜噪且泣。

translations.literal: Fan Botong and Zhang Dezheng, campaign commanders of Haozhou, held the fort and defended themselves; Shimin removed his helmet to show himself, and within the fort men rejoiced, shouted, and wept.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Botong and Zhang Dezheng, Haozhou campaign commanders, held the fort in defense. Shimin took off his helmet to reveal himself; inside the fort men cheered, shouted, and wept with joy.

sentences.zh: 左右告以王不食，獻濁酒、脫粟飯。

translations.literal: Those beside him reported that the prince had not eaten; they offered muddy wine and husked-grain rice.
translations.idiomatic: His attendants, learning the prince had not eaten, brought him coarse wine and plain rice.

sentences.zh: 尉遲敬德收餘眾守介休，世民遣任城王道宗、宇文士及往諭之，敬德與尋相舉介休及永安降。

translations.literal: Yuchi Jingde gathered the remaining troops and held Jiexiu; Shimin sent the Prince of Rencheng, Daozong, and Yuwen Shiji to instruct him; Jingde and Xun Xiang surrendered Jiexiu and Yong'an together.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchi Jingde rallied the remnants and held Jiexiu. Shimin sent Prince Daozong of Rencheng and Yuwen Shiji to parley with him; Jingde and Xun Xiang surrendered Jiexiu and Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 世民得敬德，甚喜，以為右一府統軍，使將其舊眾八千，與諸營相參。

translations.literal: Shimin, greatly pleased to have Jingde, made him commander of the Right First Guard and had him lead his former eight thousand troops, interspersed among the various camps.
translations.idiomatic: Delighted to have Jingde, Shimin made him commander of the Right First Guard and let him keep his original eight thousand men, mixed in among the other units.

sentences.zh: 屈突通慮其變，驟以為言，世民不聽。

translations.literal: Qu Tu Tong, fearing he might rebel, repeatedly spoke of this; Shimin would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Tu Tong, fearing Jingde might turn traitor, urged this repeatedly, but Shimin paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 劉武周聞金剛敗，大懼，棄并州走突厥。

translations.literal: Liu Wuzhou, hearing that Jingang was defeated, was greatly afraid; he abandoned Bingzhou and fled to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Wuzhou heard of Jingang's defeat, he panicked, abandoned Bingzhou, and fled to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 金剛收其餘眾，欲復戰，眾莫肯從，亦與百餘騎走突厥。

translations.literal: Jingang gathered the remaining troops and wished to fight again, but none would follow; he too fled to the Turks with a little more than a hundred horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Jingang tried to rally his remnants for another fight, but no one would follow. He too fled to the Turks with just over a hundred riders.

sentences.zh: 世民至晉陽，武周所署僕射楊伏念以城降。

translations.literal: Shimin reached Jinyang; Yang Funian, whom Wuzhou had appointed as grand minister, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin entered Jinyang; Yang Funian, whom Wuzhou had installed as grand minister, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 唐儉封府庫以待世民，武周所得州縣皆入於唐。

translations.literal: Tang Jian sealed the treasuries to await Shimin; all the prefectures and counties Wuzhou had taken came back to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Jian had sealed the treasuries awaiting Shimin's arrival; every prefecture and county Wuzhou had held returned to Tang.

sentences.zh: 未幾，金剛謀走上谷，突厥追獲，腰斬之。

translations.literal: Before long, Jingang plotted to flee to Shanggu; the Turks pursued and captured him and cut him in two at the waist.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Jingang tried to escape to Shanggu; the Turks caught him and executed him by cutting him in half at the waist.

sentences.zh: 嵐州總管劉六兒從宋金剛在介休，秦王世民擒斬之。

translations.literal: Liu Liu'er, commander of Lan Prefecture, had followed Song Jingang at Jiexiu; the Prince of Qin, Shimin, captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Liu'er, commander of Lan Prefecture, had served under Song Jingang at Jiexiu; the Prince of Qin captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 其兄季真，棄石州，奔劉武周將馬邑高滿政，滿政殺之。

translations.literal: His elder brother Jizhen abandoned Shizhou, fled to Liu Wuzhou's general Gao Manzheng of Mayi, and Manzheng killed him.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Jizhen abandoned Shizhou and fled to Gao Manzheng of Mayi, a general under Liu Wuzhou; Manzheng killed him.

sentences.zh: 武周之南寇也，其內史令苑君璋諫曰：「唐主舉一州之眾，直取長安，所向無敵，此乃天授，非人力也。

translations.literal: When Wuzhou marched south to raid, his director of the Secretariat, Yuan Junzhang, remonstrated, saying: "The Tang ruler raised the people of one province, took Chang'an directly, and was invincible wherever he turned—this was heaven's grant, not human power.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzhou launched his southern campaign, his Secretariat director Yuan Junzhang warned: "The Tang ruler rallied one province's strength, marched straight on Chang'an, and swept all before him—that was heaven's mandate, not mere human effort.

sentences.zh: 晉陽以南，道路險隘，縣軍深入，無繼於後，君進戰不利，何以自還！

translations.literal: South of Jinyang the roads are narrow and perilous; if you lead isolated troops deep in, with no support behind, and advance to fight without success—how will you return!
translations.idiomatic: South of Jinyang the roads are treacherous. If you drive deep with no reserves behind you and the advance goes badly—how will you get back?

sentences.zh: 不如北連突厥，南結唐朝，南面稱孤，足為長策。

translations.literal: Better to link with the Turks in the north, ally with Tang in the south, and hold yourself apart in the south—a plan sufficient for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: Better to ally with the Turks in the north and Tang in the south, and rule your own domain in the south. That is the sound strategy.

sentences.zh: 」武周不聽，留君璋守朔州。

translations.literal: " Wuzhou would not listen and left Junzhang to guard Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: " Wuzhou refused to listen and left Junzhang to hold Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 及敗，泣謂君璋曰：「不用君言，以至於此。

translations.literal: When he was defeated, weeping he said to Junzhang: "I did not heed your words, and it has come to this.
translations.idiomatic: After his defeat he wept and told Junzhang: "I ignored your counsel, and this is where it has brought me.

sentences.zh: 」久之，武周謀亡歸馬邑，事洩，突厥殺之。

translations.literal: " After some time, Wuzhou plotted to escape and return to Mayi; the affair leaked out, and the Turks killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long, Wuzhou plotted to slip back to Mayi; the plan was discovered, and the Turks killed him.

sentences.zh: 突厥又以君璋為大行臺，統其餘眾，仍令郁射設督兵助鎮。

translations.literal: The Turks again made Junzhang grand mobile headquarters commander, putting the remaining troops under him, and still had Yüshe She oversee troops to assist in garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks then made Junzhang commander of a grand mobile headquarters over Wuzhou's remaining forces, with Yüshe She supervising troops to help hold the region.

sentences.zh: 庚申，懷州總管黃君漢擊王世充太子玄應於西濟州，大破之；

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Huang Junhan, commander of Huai Prefecture, attacked Wang Shichong's crown prince Xuanying at Xijizhou and routed him;
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, Huang Junhan, commander of Huai Prefecture, attacked Wang Shichong's crown prince Xuanying at Xijizhou and routed him;

sentences.zh: 熊州行軍總管史萬寶邀之於九曲，又破之。

translations.literal: Shi Wanbao, campaign commander of Xiong Prefecture, intercepted him at Jiuqu and defeated him again.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wanbao, campaign commander of Xiong Prefecture, intercepted the retreat at Jiuqu and defeated him again.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王世充陷鄧州。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Wang Shichong captured Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Wang Shichong took Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上聞并州平，大悅。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard that Bingzhou was pacified and was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor learned that Bingzhou had been pacified, he was overjoyed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，宴群臣，賜繒帛，使自入御府，盡力取之。

translations.literal: On the day renxu he feasted the ministers, granted silk and cloth, and had them enter the imperial storehouse themselves and take as much as they could.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu he held a feast for his ministers and let them into the imperial treasury to take as much silk and cloth as they could carry.

sentences.zh: 復唐儉官爵，仍以為并州道安撫大使；

translations.literal: Tang Jian's office and rank were restored, and he was again made pacification commissioner of the Bingzhou circuit;
translations.idiomatic: Tang Jian's rank and titles were restored, and he was again appointed pacification commissioner for the Bingzhou circuit;

sentences.zh: 所籍獨孤懷恩田宅資財，悉以賜之。

translations.literal: the fields, houses, and property that had been confiscated from Dugu Huai'en were all granted to him.
translations.idiomatic: and all the lands, houses, and goods seized from Dugu Huai'en were given to him.

sentences.zh: 世民留李仲文鎮并州，劉武周數遣兵入寇，仲文輒擊破之，下城堡百餘所。

translations.literal: Shimin left Li Zhongwen to garrison Bingzhou; Liu Wuzhou repeatedly sent troops to raid in, and Zhongwen always defeated them, reducing more than a hundred forts and walled towns.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin left Li Zhongwen to hold Bingzhou. Liu Wuzhou sent raiders again and again; Zhongwen beat them back each time and captured more than a hundred forts and walled towns.

sentences.zh: 詔仲文檢校并州總管。

translations.literal: An edict made Zhongwen acting commander of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Zhongwen acting commander of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，竇建德遣高士興擊李藝於幽州，不克，退軍籠火城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Dou Jian De sent Gao Shixing to attack Li Yi at You Prefecture; he could not take it and withdrew the army to Longhuo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Dou Jiande sent Gao Shixing to attack Li Yi at You Prefecture. The assault failed, and he withdrew to Longhuo Fort.

sentences.zh: 藝襲擊，大破之，斬首五千級。

translations.literal: Yi struck in a surprise attack, routed them utterly, and took five thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yi counterattacked by surprise, crushed them, and took five thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 建德大將軍王伏寶，勇略冠軍中，諸將疾之，言其謀反，建德殺之，伏寶曰：「大王奈何聽讒言，自斬左右手乎！

translations.literal: Jian De's great general Wang Fubao was foremost in the army in courage and strategy; the other generals envied him and said he plotted rebellion; Jian De killed him; Fubao said: "Great King, why heed slander and cut off your own left and right hands!
translations.idiomatic: Jiande's great general Wang Fubao was the boldest and cleverest man in the army. The other generals envied him and accused him of treason; Jiande had him executed. Fubao cried: "My lord, why listen to slander and cut off your own right and left hands!

sentences.zh: 初，尉遲敬德將兵助呂崇茂守夏縣，上潛遣使赦崇茂罪，拜夏州刺史，使圖敬德，事洩，敬德殺之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yuchi Jingde had led troops to help Lü Chongmao hold Xia County; the Emperor secretly sent an envoy to pardon Chongmao's crimes, appoint him governor of Xia Prefecture, and have him plot against Jingde; the affair leaked out, and Jingde killed the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yuchi Jingde had helped Lü Chongmao hold Xia County. The Emperor secretly sent an envoy to pardon Chongmao, make him governor of Xia Prefecture, and turn him against Jingde. The plot was discovered, and Jingde killed the envoy.

sentences.zh: 敬德去，崇茂餘黨復據夏縣拒守。

translations.literal: When Jingde departed, Chongmao's remaining followers again seized Xia County and held out in resistance.
translations.idiomatic: After Jingde left, Chongmao's remaining followers reoccupied Xia County and held it against Tang.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民引軍自晉州還攻夏縣，壬午，屠之。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin, Shimin, led troops from Jin Prefecture back to attack Xia County; on the day renwu he slaughtered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin marched back from Jin Prefecture and assaulted Xia County; on the day renwu he put the city to the sword.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，秦王世民至長安。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Prince of Qin, Shimin, reached Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao the Prince of Qin arrived in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 是月，突厥遣阿史那揭多獻馬千匹於王世充，且求婚；

translations.literal: That month the Turks sent Ashina Jieduo to present a thousand horses to Wang Shichong and also to seek a marriage alliance;
translations.idiomatic: That month the Turks sent Ashina Jieduo to Wang Shichong with a gift of a thousand horses and a proposal of marriage;

sentences.zh: 世充以宗女妻之，並與之互市。

translations.literal: Shichong gave a clanswoman in marriage and also established mutual trade with them.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong gave him a princess of his clan in marriage and opened border trade with the Turks.

sentences.zh: 六月，壬辰，詔以和州總管、東南道行臺尚書令楚王杜伏威為使持節、總管江淮以南諸軍事、揚州刺史、東南道行臺尚書令、淮南道安撫使，進封吳王，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renchen, an edict made Du Fuwei, Duke of Chu, commander of He Prefecture and chief minister of the Southeast Circuit mobile headquarters, bearer of the imperial insignia, overall commander of all military affairs south of the Yangtze and Huai, governor of Yang Prefecture, chief minister of the Southeast Circuit mobile headquarters, and pacification commissioner of the Huainan circuit; he was advanced to Prince of Wu and granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day renchen, an edict appointed Du Fuwei—Duke of Chu, commander of He Prefecture and chief minister of the Southeast mobile headquarters—as bearer of the imperial insignia, supreme commander of all forces south of the Yangtze and Huai, governor of Yang Prefecture, chief minister of the Southeast headquarters, and Huainan pacification commissioner. He was promoted to Prince of Wu and given the surname Li.

sentences.zh: 以輔公祏為行臺左僕射，封舒國公。

translations.literal: Fu Gongshi was made left vice minister of the mobile headquarters and enfeoffed as Duke of Shuguo.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Gongshi was made left vice minister of the mobile headquarters and enfeoffed as Duke of Shuguo.

sentences.zh: 丙午，立皇子元景為趙王，元昌為魯王，元亨為魯王。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the imperial sons Yuanjing, Yuanchang, and Yuanheng were established as Prince of Zhao, Prince of Lu, and Prince of Lu respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu the princes Yuanjing, Yuanchang, and Yuanheng were enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao, Prince of Lu, and Prince of Lu respectively.

sentences.zh: 顯州行臺尚書令楚公楊士林，雖受唐官爵，而北結王世充，南通蕭銑；

translations.literal: Yang Sulin, Duke of Chu and chief minister of the Xianzhou Circuit mobile headquarters, though he received Tang offices and ranks, allied with Wang Shichong in the north and Xiao Xian in the south;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sulin, Duke of Chu and chief minister of the Xianzhou mobile headquarters, held Tang rank but allied with Wang Shichong in the north and Xiao Xian in the south;

sentences.zh: 詔廬江王瑗與安撫使李弘敏討之。

translations.literal: an edict ordered the Prince of Lujiang, Yuan, and the pacification commissioner Li Hongmin to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: an edict ordered Prince Yuan of Lujiang and Pacification Commissioner Li Hongmin to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 兵未行，長史田瓚為士林所忌，甲寅，瓚殺士林，降於世充，世充以瓚為顯州總管。

translations.literal: Before the troops marched, the chief administrator Tian Zan was envied by Sulin; on the day jiayin, Zan killed Sulin, surrendered to Shichong, and Shichong made Zan commander of Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before the army could march, Chief Administrator Tian Zan, whom Sulin had come to distrust, killed Sulin on the day jiayin and surrendered to Shichong, who made him commander of Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民之討劉武周也，突厥處羅可汗遣其弟步利設帥二千騎助唐。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Qin, Shimin, was campaigning against Liu Wuzhou, the Turkic khan Chelu sent his younger brother Bili She to lead two thousand horsemen to aid Tang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Prince of Qin's campaign against Liu Wuzhou, the Turkic khan Chelu sent his brother Bili She with two thousand cavalry to aid Tang.

sentences.zh: 武周既敗，是月，處羅至晉陽，總管李仲文不能制；

translations.literal: After Wuzhou was defeated, that month Chelu came to Jinyang; the commander Li Zhongwen could not control him;
translations.idiomatic: After Wuzhou's defeat, Chelu arrived at Jinyang that same month; Commander Li Zhongwen could not restrain him;

sentences.zh: 又留倫特勒，使將數百人，雲助仲文鎮守，自石嶺以北，皆留兵戍之而去。

translations.literal: he also left Luntele to lead several hundred men, saying they would help Zhongwen garrison the region; from Shiling northward he left troops on guard everywhere and then departed.
translations.idiomatic: he left Luntele with several hundred men, ostensibly to help Zhongwen garrison the region, posted guards from Shiling northward, and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 上議擊王世充，世充聞之，選諸州鎮驍勇皆集洛陽，置四鎮將軍，募人分守四城。

translations.literal: The Emperor deliberated on attacking Wang Shichong; Shichong, hearing of it, selected the bravest garrison troops from all prefectures and gathered them at Luoyang, appointed four frontier generals, and recruited men to divide and guard the four cities.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor planned an attack on Wang Shichong. Hearing of it, Shichong summoned the fiercest garrison troops from every prefecture to Luoyang, appointed four frontier generals, and drafted men to hold the four outer cities.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，壬戌，詔秦王世民督諸軍擊世充。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renxu, an edict ordered the Prince of Qin, Shimin, to oversee all armies in attacking Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renxu, an edict put the Prince of Qin in command of all forces against Shichong.

sentences.zh: 陝東道行臺屈突通二子在洛陽，上謂通曰：「今欲使卿東征，如卿二子何？

translations.literal: Qu Tu Tong of the Shaan East Circuit mobile headquarters had two sons in Luoyang; the Emperor said to Tong: "Now I wish to send you east on campaign—what of your two sons?
translations.idiomatic: Qu Tu Tong of the Shaan East mobile headquarters had two sons held in Luoyang. The Emperor asked him: "I mean to send you east to fight—what of your two sons?

sentences.zh: 」通曰：「臣昔為俘囚，分當就死，陛下釋縛，加以恩禮。

translations.literal: " Tong said: "Your servant was once a captive prisoner and by right should have died; Your Majesty released my bonds and treated me with grace and honor.
translations.idiomatic: " Tong replied: "I was once your captive and deserved death. Your Majesty freed me and honored me with kindness.

sentences.zh: 當是之時，臣心口相誓，期以更生餘年為陛下盡節，但恐不獲死所耳。

translations.literal: At that time your servant vowed in heart and word to spend the years of renewed life in utmost loyalty to Your Majesty—I only feared not finding a place to die.
translations.idiomatic: From that day I swore in my heart to spend whatever years remained in your service—I only feared I might never find a worthy place to die.

sentences.zh: 今得備先驅，二兒何足顧乎！

translations.literal: Now that I may serve in the vanguard, what are two sons worth considering!
translations.idiomatic: Now that I may serve in the vanguard, what are two sons to me!

sentences.zh: 」上歎曰：「徇義之士，一至此乎！

translations.literal: " The Emperor sighed and said: "A man who gives himself to righteousness—to this extent!
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor sighed: "Devotion to duty can go this far!

sentences.zh: 癸亥，突厥遣使潛詣王世充，潞州總管李襲譽邀擊，敗之，虜牛羊萬計。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the Turks secretly sent envoys to Wang Shichong; Li Xiyu, commander of Lu Prefecture, intercepted and defeated them, capturing cattle and sheep by the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai Turkic envoys tried to reach Wang Shichong in secret; Li Xiyu, commander of Lu Prefecture, intercepted them, routed the escort, and seized tens of thousands of cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍可朱渾定遠告：「并州總管李仲文與突厥通謀，欲俟洛陽兵交，引胡騎直入長安。

translations.literal: The general of flying cavalry Kezhuhun Dingyuan reported: "The commander of Bingzhou, Li Zhongwen, is in secret collusion with the Turks and wishes to wait until the armies clash at Luoyang, then lead Turkic horsemen straight into Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: General Kezhuhun Dingyuan reported: "Commander Li Zhongwen of Bingzhou is conspiring with the Turks. He plans to wait until the armies meet at Luoyang, then lead Turkic cavalry straight into Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，命皇太子鎮蒲板以備之，又遣禮部尚書唐儉安撫并州，暫廢并州總管府，征仲文入朝。

translations.literal: " On the day jiaxu the crown prince was ordered to garrison Puban as a precaution; the Minister of Rites Tang Jian was also sent to pacify Bingzhou; the Bingzhou command headquarters was temporarily abolished; and Zhongwen was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: " On the day jiaxu the crown prince was posted at Puban as a precaution. Tang Jian, Minister of Rites, was sent to pacify Bingzhou, the Bingzhou command was temporarily dissolved, and Zhongwen was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 壬午，秦王世民至新安。

translations.literal: On the day renwu the Prince of Qin, Shimin, reached Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu the Prince of Qin reached Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 王世充遣魏王弘烈鎮襄陽，荊王行本鎮虎牢，宋王泰鎮懷州，齊王世惲檢校南城，楚王世偉守寶城，太子玄應守東城，漢王玄恕守含嘉城，魯王道徇守曜儀城，世充自將戰兵，左輔大將軍楊公卿帥左龍驤二十八府騎兵，右游擊大將軍郭善才帥內軍二十八府步兵，左游擊大將軍跋野綱帥外軍二十八府步兵，總三萬人，以備唐。

translations.literal: Wang Shichong sent the Prince of Wei, Honglie, to garrison Xiangyang; the Prince of Jing, Xingben, to garrison Hulao; the Prince of Song, Tai, to garrison Huai Prefecture; the Prince of Qi, Shiyun, to inspect the southern city; the Prince of Chu, Shiwei, to hold Baocheng; the crown prince Xuanying to hold the eastern city; the Prince of Han, Xuanshu, to hold Hanjia Fort; the Prince of Lu, Daoxun, to hold Yaoyi Fort; Shichong himself led the battle troops; the Left Assistant Grand General Yang Gongqing commanded the twenty-eight guards of the Left Dragon Charger cavalry; the Right Mobile Strike Grand General Guo Shancai commanded the twenty-eight guards of the inner army infantry; the Left Mobile Strike Grand General Baye Gang commanded the twenty-eight guards of the outer army infantry—in all thirty thousand men—to prepare against Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong deployed his forces: Prince Honglie of Wei at Xiangyang, Prince Xingben of Jing at Hulao, Prince Tai of Song at Huai Prefecture, Prince Shiyun of Qi to oversee the southern city, Prince Shiwei of Chu at Baocheng, Crown Prince Xuanying at the eastern city, Prince Xuanshu of Han at Hanjia Fort, and Prince Daoxun of Lu at Yaoyi Fort. Shichong himself took the field with thirty thousand battle troops—Yang Gongqing leading the Left Dragon Charger cavalry from twenty-eight guards, Guo Shancai the inner army infantry from twenty-eight guards, and Baye Gang the outer army infantry from twenty-eight guards—to meet Tang.

sentences.zh: 弘烈、行本，世偉之子；

translations.literal: Honglie and Xingben were Shiwei's sons;
translations.idiomatic: Honglie and Xingben were sons of Shiwei;

sentences.zh: 泰，世充之兄子也。

translations.literal: Tai was Shichong's elder brother's son.
translations.idiomatic: Tai was Shichong's nephew.

sentences.zh: 梁師都引突厥、稽胡兵入寇，行軍總管段德操擊破之，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: Liang Shidu led Turkic and Ji Hu troops in a raid; the campaign commander Duan Decao defeated them and took more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shidu led Turkic and Ji Hu raiders across the border; Campaign Commander Duan Decao routed them and took over a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 羅士信將前鋒圍慈澗，王世充自將兵三萬救之。

translations.literal: Luo Shixin led the vanguard in besieging Cijian; Wang Shichong personally led thirty thousand troops to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shixin led the vanguard in the siege of Cijian; Wang Shichong marched out personally with thirty thousand men to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 己丑，秦王世民將輕騎前覘世充，猝與之遇，眾寡不敵，道路險扼，為世充所圍。

translations.literal: On the day jichou the Prince of Qin, Shimin, led light cavalry forward to reconnoiter Shichong; he suddenly encountered him; his force was too few to match the enemy; the road was narrow and blocked, and he was surrounded by Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou the Prince of Qin rode ahead with a light escort to scout Shichong's position and ran into him unexpectedly. Outnumbered on a narrow road, he was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 世民左右馳射，皆應弦而斃，獲其左建威將軍燕琪，世充乃退。

translations.literal: Shimin galloped left and right shooting; all fell at the twang of the bowstring; he captured Shichong's Left Establishing Might General Yan Qi, and Shichong then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin wheeled and shot in every direction; every arrow found its mark. He captured Shichong's general Yan Qi, and Shichong pulled back.

sentences.zh: 世民還營，埃塵覆面，軍不復識，欲拒之，世民免冑自言，乃得入。

translations.literal: Shimin returned to camp; dust covered his face; the army no longer recognized him and wished to repel him; Shimin removed his helmet and announced himself, and only then was he admitted.
translations.idiomatic: When Shimin rode back to camp, dust masked his face so completely that his own men did not recognize him and nearly turned him away. He removed his helmet and announced himself before they let him in.

sentences.zh: 旦日，帥步騎五萬進軍慈澗；

translations.literal: At dawn the next day he led fifty thousand foot and horse in advancing on Cijian;
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day he advanced on Cijian with fifty thousand infantry and cavalry;

sentences.zh: 世充拔慈澗之戍，歸於洛陽。

translations.literal: Shichong withdrew the garrison at Cijian and returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong pulled the garrison out of Cijian and withdrew to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 世民遣行軍總管史萬寶自宜陽南據龍門，將軍劉德威自太行東圍河內，上谷公王君廓自洛口斷其餉道，懷州總管黃君漢自河陰攻回洛城；

translations.literal: Shimin dispatched Campaign Commander Shi Wanbao from Yiyang south to occupy Longmen; General Liu Dewei from east of the Taihang to besiege Henei; the Duke of Shanggu, Wang Junkuo, from Luokou to cut off his supply routes; and Huai Prefecture Commander Huang Junhan from Heyin to attack Huiluo City;
translations.idiomatic: Shimin sent Campaign Commander Shi Wanbao south from Yiyang to seize Longmen, General Liu Dewei east from the Taihang to invest Henei, Duke Wang Junkuo of Shanggu from Luokou to sever supply lines, and Huai Prefecture Commander Huang Junhan from Heyin to assault Huiluo City;

sentences.zh: 大軍屯於北邙，連營以逼之。

translations.literal: The main army encamped at Mount Beimang, establishing linked camps to press him.
translations.idiomatic: The main force encamped on Mount Beimang in a chain of camps to tighten the siege.

sentences.zh: 世充洧州長史繁水張公謹與刺史崔樞以州城來降。

translations.literal: Shichong's Weizhou Chief Clerk Zhang Gongjin of Fanshui and Prefect Cui Shu surrendered the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gongjin of Fanshui, chief clerk of Weizhou, and Prefect Cui Shu surrendered the prefectural seat to Tang.

sentences.zh: 八月，丁酉，南寧西爨蠻遣使入貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, the Cuan tribes of western Nanning sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, the western Cuan tribes of Nanning sent tribute envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 初，隋末蠻酋爨玩反，誅，諸子沒為官奴，棄其地。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the end of Sui, the tribal chieftain Cuan Wan rebelled, was executed, and his sons were confiscated as government slaves; the land was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Sui, the Cuan chieftain Wan had rebelled and been put to death; his sons were seized as government slaves and his territory left without a ruler.

sentences.zh: 帝即位，以玩子弘達為昆州刺史，令持其父屍歸葬；

translations.literal: When the emperor took the throne, he appointed Wan's son Hongda as prefect of Kunzhou and ordered him to take his father's corpse home for burial;
translations.idiomatic: When the Tang emperor came to the throne, he named Wan's son Hongda prefect of Kunzhou and sent him to bring his father's remains home for burial;

sentences.zh: 益州刺史段綸因遣使招諭其部落，皆來降。

translations.literal: The Yi Prefecture governor Duan Lun therefore sent envoys to summon and instruct their tribes; all came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefecture Governor Duan Lun then sent envoys to win over the tribes, and they all submitted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，竇建德共州縣令唐綱殺刺史，以州來降。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Dou Jiande's Gong Prefecture magistrate Tang Gang killed the prefect and surrendered the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Tang Gang, magistrate of Gong Prefecture under Dou Jiande, killed the prefect and brought the prefecture over to Tang.

sentences.zh: 鄧州土豪執王世充所署剌史來降。

translations.literal: A local magnate of Deng Prefecture seized the prefect appointed by Wang Shichong and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: A Deng Prefecture magnate arrested Wang Shichong's appointee as prefect and defected to Tang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，梁師都石堡留守張舉帥千餘人來降。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Liang Shidu's Shibao garrison commander Zhang Ju led more than a thousand men to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, Zhang Ju, garrison commander at Shibao under Liang Shidu, arrived with a thousand men to surrender.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，黃君漢遣校尉張夜叉以舟師襲回洛城，克之，獲其將達奚善定，斷河陽南橋而還，降其堡聚二十餘。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Huang Junhan sent Commandant Zhang Yecha with a river force to strike Huiluo City, captured it, took its general Daxi Shanding, severed the southern bridge of Heyang and returned, and received the surrender of more than twenty forts and settlements.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, Huang Junhan dispatched Commandant Zhang Yecha with river troops against Huiluo City. They took the city, captured the general Daxi Shanding, destroyed the southern Heyang bridge, and on their return accepted the submission of over twenty fortified settlements.

sentences.zh: 世充使太子玄應帥楊公卿等攻回洛，不克，乃築月城於其西，留兵戍之。

translations.literal: Shichong sent the crown prince Xuanying leading Yang Gongqing and others to attack Huiluo, failed to capture it, and thereupon built a crescent fort west of it, leaving troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong sent Crown Prince Xuanying with Yang Gongqing and others to retake Huiluo; when the assault failed, they built a crescent fort to the west and left a garrison there.

sentences.zh: 世充陳於青城宮，秦王世民亦置陳當之。

translations.literal: Shichong drew up battle lines at Qingcheng Palace; the Prince of Qin, Shimin, also deployed his formation to face him.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong formed his battle line at Qingcheng Palace; the Prince of Qin deployed opposite him.

sentences.zh: 世充隔水謂世民曰：「隋室傾覆，唐帝關中，鄭帝河南，世充未嘗西侵，王忽舉兵東來，何也？

translations.literal: Shichong called across the water to Shimin and said, "The Sui house has fallen; Tang holds Guanzhong and Zheng holds Henan—Shichong has never invaded the west. Why has Your Highness suddenly raised troops and come east?"
translations.idiomatic: Shichong shouted across the water to Shimin, "The Sui dynasty is gone. Tang rules in the west and Zheng in the east. I have never marched west—why have you suddenly brought an army east?"

sentences.zh: 」世民使宇文士及應之曰：「四海咸仰皇風，唯公獨阻聲教，為此而來！

translations.literal: " Shimin had Yuwen Shiji reply, "All within the four seas look up to the emperor's transforming influence—only you alone block his civilizing command. That is why I have come!"
translations.idiomatic: " Shimin sent Yuwen Shiji to answer: "The whole realm looks to the emperor's virtue—you alone stand in the way. That is why we are here."

sentences.zh: 」世充曰：「相與息兵講好，不亦善乎！

translations.literal: " Shichong said, "For us to cease arms and make peace—would that not be good!"
translations.idiomatic: " Shichong called back, "Would it not be better for us to lay down arms and make peace?"

sentences.zh: 」又應之曰：「奉詔取東都，不令講好也！

translations.literal: " He replied again, "I am under orders to take the Eastern Capital—I am not authorized to make peace!"
translations.idiomatic: " The reply came again: "I have orders to take the Eastern Capital—not to negotiate peace."

sentences.zh: 」至暮，各引兵還。

translations.literal: " At dusk each side withdrew its troops.
translations.idiomatic: " At nightfall both sides withdrew.

sentences.zh: 上遣使與竇建德連和，建德遣同安長公主隨使者俱還。

translations.literal: The emperor sent envoys to ally with Dou Jiande; Jiande sent the Princess of Tong'an to return with the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent envoys to treaty with Dou Jiande; Jiande sent the Princess of Tong'an back with them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，劉德威襲懷州，入其外郭，下其堡聚。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Liu Dewei raided Huai Prefecture, entered its outer city, and subdued its forts and settlements.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, Liu Dewei struck Huai Prefecture, broke into the outer city, and reduced its outlying forts.

sentences.zh: 九月，庚午，梁師都將劉旻以華池來降，以為林州總管。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengwu, Liang Shidu's officer Liu Min surrendered Huachi and was appointed Linzhou Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day gengwu, Liu Min, a commander under Liang Shidu, surrendered Huachi and was made commander of Lin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王世充顯州總管田瓚以所部二十五州來降；

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Wang Shichong's Xianzhou Commander Tian Zan surrendered the twenty-five prefectures under his command;
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Tian Zan, Wang Shichong's commander of Xian Prefecture, defected with twenty-five prefectures under his authority;

sentences.zh: 自是襄陽聲問與世充絕。

translations.literal: From this time contact between Xiangyang and Shichong was severed.
translations.idiomatic: After that, Xiangyang was cut off from all communication with Shichong.

sentences.zh: 史萬寶進軍甘泉宮。

translations.literal: Shi Wanbao advanced his army to Ganquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wanbao marched on Ganquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，秦王世民遣右武衛將軍王君廓攻轘轅，拔之。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Prince of Qin, Shimin, sent Right Martial Guard General Wang Junkuo to attack Huyao and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, the Prince of Qin sent Right Martial Guard General Wang Junkuo against Huyao and took it.

sentences.zh: 王世充遣其將魏隱等擊君廓，君廓偽遁，設伏，大破之，遂東徇地，至管城而還。

translations.literal: Wang Shichong sent his generals Wei Yin and others to strike Junkuo; Junkuo feigned flight, set an ambush, and routed them utterly; he then marched east seizing territory as far as Guancheng and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong sent Wei Yin and others against Junkuo. Junkuo pretended to flee, laid an ambush, and inflicted a crushing defeat, then swept east as far as Guancheng before turning back.

sentences.zh: 先是，王世充將郭士衡、許羅漢掠唐境，君廓以策擊卻之，詔勞之曰：「卿以十三人破賊一萬，自古以少制眾，未之有也。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wang Shichong's generals Guo Shiheng and Xu Luohan had raided Tang territory; Junkuo by stratagem repulsed them; an edict commended him, saying, "You with thirteen men broke ten thousand enemy troops—since antiquity, to defeat the many with the few has never been seen."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wang Shichong's generals Guo Shiheng and Xu Luohan had raided Tang soil; Junkuo drove them off by stratagem. An imperial message praised him: "You routed ten thousand enemies with thirteen men—a feat without parallel in history."

sentences.zh: 世充尉州剌史時德睿帥所部杞、夏、陳、隨、許、穎、尉七州來降。

translations.literal: Shichong's Yuzhou Prefect Shi Derui led the seven prefectures under his command—Qi, Xia, Chen, Sui, Xu, Ying, and Yu—to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Derui, prefect of Yu Prefecture under Shichong, brought over seven prefectures—Qi, Xia, Chen, Sui, Xu, Ying, and Yu.

sentences.zh: 秦王世民以便宜命州縣官並依世充所署，無所變易，改尉州為南汴州，於是河南州縣相繼來降。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin, Shimin, exercising discretion, ordered that prefecture and county officials all remain as appointed by Shichong without change; Yu Prefecture was renamed Southern Bian Prefecture; thereupon prefectures and counties of Henan surrendered in succession.
